create_persistent_client_from_registry: create a PersistentClient by selecting a random server from a registry directory path
run_command_in_session: run a command in an existing session and return the output with exit code
submit_background_task: submit a command to run in the background and return a task ID for later polling
check_task_status: check the status of a background task and retrieve its result when done
fetch_task_result_until_success: poll a background task repeatedly until it completes and return the final result
